_meta.note: Registry mirror pointer for the CN-PIPL-2021 compliance pack. The canonical pack manifest lives at packs/cn/compliance/manifest.json (Wave-1+2 output). This pointer registers the pack in the governance microservice's pack-registry directory so the governance µservice can enumerate active packs via its registry scan without reading the global packs/ tree directly. Pattern: every compliance pack that activates governance-µservice Cedar fragments (consent-gating, DSAR-response, cross-border-transfer-gating) MUST have a registry mirror entry here.
